results.title: 4/ So this isn't just about Chinese manufacturers.
results.description: 4/ So this isn't just about Chinese manufacturers. A German or Japanese TBM maker building in China must now formally ask Beijing before shipping to India. A factory in China has become a liability for any firm that wants to serve the Indian market.

results.title: 3/ The design matters more.
results.description: 3/ The design matters more. Exports to "countries in dispute with China" need a licence. India is obviously a major target. Everyone else must promise not to pass the machines to such countries. Firms outside China can't transfer China-origin items there either.
